mapper.select: SELECT ID,task_id,task_thread_desc,task_thread_cron,tesk_thread_sort FROM system_docking.api_task_thread_ins WHERE task_id=#{processId} AND is_enable='1' ORDER BY tesk_thread_sort
SELECT ID,system_id,platfrom_code,platfrom_name,platform_desc FROM system_docking.api_interface_system_platform_info WHERE system_id=#{systemId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT ID,platform_id,index_code,index_name,index_desc FROM system_docking.api_platform_index_info WHERE platform_id=#{platformId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT ID,platform_id,resource_code,resource_mac,resource_desc FROM system_docking.api_system_resource WHERE platform_id=#{platformId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT ID,resource_id,ip_address FROM system_docking.api_system_resource_ip WHERE resource_id=#{resourceId} AND is_enable='1'
SELECT * FROM ${params.dataBase}.api_system_records WHERE api_status <> '200' AND api_count < ${params.restartCount}

update.foreach: UPDATE ${params.dataBase}.api_system_records SET api_status=#{item.statusCode}, add_time=#{item.addTime}, api_count=(api_count + #{item.restartCount}) WHERE ID=#{item.ID}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM system.tables t WHERE t.database =#{params.dataBase} AND t.name =#{params.tableName}

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${params.dataBase}.${params.tableName} ( `ID` String, `system_id` Nullable(String), `platform_id` Nullable(String), `index_id` Nullable(String), `resource_id` Nullable(String), `resource_code` Nullable(String), `resource_ip` Nullable(String), `time` Nullable(String), `content` Nullable(String), `ADD_DATE` Date ) ENGINE=MergeTree(ADD_DATE,(ID),8192);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS upm.netperformanceeventlog_${params.tableMonth} ( `id` String, `category` Nullable(String), `name` Nullable(String), `lineId` Nullable(String), `netsegmentId1` Nullable(String), `netsegmentId2` Nullable(String), `level` Nullable(String), `time` Nullable(String), `triggerCondition` Nullable(String), `probeId` Nullable(String), `ADD_DATE` Date ) ENGINE=MergeTree(ADD_DATE,(id),8192);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS upm.alarmlogabnormalbehavior_${params.tableMonth} ( `id` String, `category` Nullable(String), `name` Nullable(String), `clientIpAddr` Nullable(String), `clientPort` Nullable(String), `clientNetsegmentId` Nullable(String), `serverIpAddr` Nullable(String), `serverPort` Nullable(String), `serverNetsegmentId` Nullable(String), `ipAddr` Nullable(String), `netsegmentId` Nullable(String), `level` Nullable(String), `time` Nullable(String), `triggerCondition` Nullable(String), `probeId` Nullable(String), `ADD_DATE` Date ) ENGINE=MergeTree(ADD_DATE,(id),8192);
